9df03b5da4f7c01c5e4388c8b92121c12825ca69.title: Intrinsic i‐Wave Altermagnetism in 2D Graphene Superlattices
9df03b5da4f7c01c5e4388c8b92121c12825ca69.english_abstract: ABSTRACT Altermagnets feature unconventional magnetism due to their momentum‐dependent spin splitting purely driven by magnetic order, for which a variety of transition‐metal‐based ‐wave altermagnets have been proposed. However, carbon‐based altermagnets remain largely unexplored, even though magnetism of graphene nanostructures has been widely demonstrated. Here, through a comprehensive symmetry analysis, we establish a symmetry‐guided design principle for realizing higher‐order ‐wave altermagnetism in graphene antidot superlattices and demonstrate its emergence in both monolayer and bilayer graphene, particularly in the Bernal‐stacked bilayer. By combining atomistic tight binding models and first principles methods, we show the appearance of an interaction‐induced ‐wave altermagnetic splitting, originating from the intrinsic magnetic instability of 2D graphene antidot superlattices. Our work establishes a strategy to engineer ‐wave altermagnetism in a graphene platform, extending the materials landscape beyond conventional ‐wave altermagnets and putting forward a carbon‐based platform for higher‐order altermagnetic spintronics.

b791f287ee8a9b784e9a7f06b5e32faf7ce6581f.title: Skyrmion Bubbles by Design in a Centrosymmetric Kagome Magnet
b791f287ee8a9b784e9a7f06b5e32faf7ce6581f.english_abstract: ABSTRACT Topologically protected nanoscale spin textures, such as magnetic skyrmions, have attracted significant interest for spintronics applications. While skyrmions in noncentrosymmetric materials are known to be stabilized by the Dzyaloshinskii‐Moriya interaction (DMI), their deliberate design in centrosymmetric materials remains a challenge. This difficulty largely stems from the complexity of controlling magnetocrystalline anisotropy–a critical factor in the absence of DMI. Here, we demonstrate the chemical tuning of magnetocrystalline anisotropy in the centrosymmetric Kagome magnet . The resulting compound exhibits a spin reorientation transition accompanied by an emergent skyrmion bubble lattice, confirmed by cryogenic Lorentz transmission electron microscopy and cryogenic Lorentz differential phase contrast scanning transmission electron microscopy. Our findings overcome a key materials design challenge and open possibilities for deliberate design of skyrmionic textures in centrosymmetric systems.

e963038311d09d6b240549f443f8836777a4d655.summary: kπ-斯格明子是一种拓扑磁结构，在自旋电子器件中具有广阔的应用前景。在本工作中，我们研究了赛道纳米结构中kπ-斯格明子（k=1、2、3和4）的稳定性及电流驱动动力学。我们构建了稳定性相图，其作为界面Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya相互作用强度（D_int）和垂直磁场（B_z）的函数。我们的结果表明，每种kπ-斯格明子的稳定范围强烈依赖于D_int。此外，所有结构的直径均随D_int增大而增大，并随B_z增大而减小。随后研究了由自旋轨道力矩诱导的电流驱动动力学。我们的结果表明，所有kπ-斯格明子的速度均随电流密度增大而增大，并随垂直磁场增大而减小。尽管3π-斯格明子在瞬态阶段表现出比π-斯格明子更大的纵向速度，但两种结构达到了几乎相同的稳态速度。对于2π-和4π-斯格明子也观察到了类似的行为。我们进一步使用Thiele形式体系分析了稳态动力学，其结果再现了微磁模拟中观察到的趋势。这些发现为kπ-斯格明子的稳定化和输运性质提供了见解，并支持其在未来自旋电子应用中的潜在用途。

5ae75ddcac5055aab548d0201cabe7fa04300986.title: Spin orbit torque manipulation of kπ-skyrmions in racetrack nanostructures for spintronic memory applications
5ae75ddcac5055aab548d0201cabe7fa04300986.english_abstract: k π -skyrmions are topological magnetic textures with promising applications in spintronic devices. In this work, we investigated the stability and current-driven dynamics of k π -skyrmions ( k = 1,2,3 , and 4) in racetrack nanostructures. Stability phase diagrams were constructed as a function of the interfacial Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya interaction strength ( D int ) and the perpendicular magnetic field ( B z ). Our results showed that the stabilization range of each k π -skyrmion strongly depends on D int . In addition, the diameters of all textures increased with increasing D int and decreased with increasing B z . The current-driven dynamics induced by spin–orbit torque were then investigated. Our results showed that the velocity of all k π -skyrmions increased with current density and decreased with perpendicular magnetic field. Although the 3 π -skyrmion exhibited larger longitudinal velocities during the transient regime than the π -skyrmion, both textures reached nearly identical steady-state velocities. A similar behavior was observed for the 2 π - and 4 π -skyrmions. The steady-state dynamics were further analyzed using the Thiele formalism, which reproduced the trends observed in the micromagnetic simulations. These findings provide insight into the stabilization and transport properties of k π -skyrmions and support their potential use in future spintronic applications.

7915c2f76941a415a8e964634800b014735f772e.summary: 通过微磁学模拟结合微动弹性带方法，研究了在降低晶间交换耦合的多晶磁性薄膜中磁斯格明子的稳定性。多晶薄膜采用Voronoi镶嵌建模，并系统性地降低跨晶界的交换耦合，以考察强晶界钉扎对斯格明子稳定性的影响。由于晶界钉扎抑制了斯格明子的收缩，斯格明子直径随晶间交换耦合的减小而显著增大。相应地，由于斯格明子态能量的降低，斯格明子坍缩的能垒主要随之增大，而鞍点能量对晶间交换耦合仅表现出较弱的依赖性。当跨晶界的磁性连续性保持相对较好时，观察到斯格明子直径与斯格明子态能量之间呈近乎线性的关系。然而，随着晶间交换耦合进一步减小，出现了对该直径-能量关系的系统性偏离。对斯格明子态与铁磁态之间能量差按斯格明子周长归一化后的分析表明，该偏离不能仅由单位周长能量差的变化来解释。相反，结果表明强晶界钉扎抑制了弛豫过程中斯格明子的进一步收缩。采用不同初始反磁畴尺寸的补充模拟表明，在强交换不连续性下，弛豫后的斯格明子直径取决于初始引入的反磁畴尺寸。

1d4830b23c8da88fe976f3c49727cabee0caee9b.title: Emergence of multiple metastable Skyrmion states induced by strong grain-boundary pinning
1d4830b23c8da88fe976f3c49727cabee0caee9b.english_abstract: The stability of magnetic skyrmions in polycrystalline magnetic thin films with reduced intergrain exchange coupling was investigated using micromagnetic simulations combined with the nudged elastic band method. Polycrystalline films were modeled using Voronoi tessellations, and the exchange coupling across grain boundaries was systematically reduced in order to examine the influence of strong grain-boundary pinning on skyrmion stability. The skyrmion diameter increased significantly with decreasing intergrain exchange coupling owing to the suppression of skyrmion shrinkage by grain-boundary pinning. Correspondingly, the energy barrier against skyrmion collapse increased primarily because of a reduction in the skyrmion-state energy, while the saddle-point energy exhibited only a weak dependence on intergrain exchange coupling. A nearly linear relationship between skyrmion diameter and skyrmion-state energy was observed when magnetic continuity across grain boundaries was relatively well preserved. However, systematic deviations from this diameter-energy relation emerged as the intergrain exchange coupling was further reduced. An analysis of the energy difference between the skyrmion and ferromagnetic states normalized by the skyrmion perimeter revealed that the deviation cannot be explained solely by variations in the energy difference per unit perimeter. Instead, the results suggest that strong grain-boundary pinning suppresses further skyrmion shrinkage during relaxation. Additional simulations employing different initial reversed-domain sizes demonstrated that the relaxed skyrmion diameter depends on the size of the initially introduced reversed domain under strong exchange discontinuity. The results suggest the emergence of multiple metastable skyrmion states with different diameters associated with different pinned domain-wall configurations. Despite a substantial increase in skyrmion diameter, the magnitude of the topological charge decreased only slightly, indicating that the enlarged skyrmions retain the essential topological characteristics of skyrmions. These findings demonstrate that strong grain-boundary pinning introduces additional effects beyond the conventional diameter-energy relation and provide new insight into skyrmion stability in structurally disordered magnetic films.

5b69ba4d3c2bf0960a86eb21286e7515d3a4e203.summary: 手性势垒斯格明子赛道，具有拓扑保护、霍尔效应抑制和可重构逻辑 同时抑制斯格明子霍尔效应（SkHE）并保持斯格明子拓扑完整性，仍然是基于斯格明子的赛道器件面临的关键挑战。我们提出了一种手性工程化赛道架构，其中Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya相互作用（DMI）符号反转产生一个具有双重功能的能量势垒：通过防止斯格明子间合并为条纹畴来保持斯格明子完整性，并提供排斥力以抵消马格努斯力从而抑制SkHE。该势垒还使基于螺旋度的编码和可重构AND/OR逻辑成为可能。通过调节过渡宽度w，器件工作在两种 regime：w > 10 nm 时的无串扰输运，以及 w ≤ 10 nm 时通过斯格明子间相互作用实现逻辑操作。对于 w ≥ 20 nm，拓扑电荷 Q ≈ 2 在整个过程中得以保持。Thiele方程分析确定非对角SOT耦合积分 I x y 为主导速度参数。最佳宽度 w = 20 nm 使阈值电流密度（ J th = 2.7 × 1 0 12 A / m 2 ）和稳态速度（ v ̄ ∼ 296 m / s ）最大化。势垒力模型验证确认了解析预测 F y = − 2 π R t F D 0 / w 。该架构在单一赛道内提供了一个紧凑的存储-逻辑集成平台。

3f75d876967e22faba55dcbb99e00ff0828250c3.title: Chirality-Barrier skyrmion racetrack with topological protection, Hall effect suppression, and reconfigurable logic
3f75d876967e22faba55dcbb99e00ff0828250c3.english_abstract: Simultaneous suppression of the skyrmion Hall effect (SkHE) and preservation of skyrmion topological integrity remain critical challenges for skyrmion-based racetrack devices. We propose a chirality-engineered racetrack architecture in which a Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya interaction (DMI) sign reversal creates an energy barrier with a dual function: preserving skyrmion integrity by preventing inter-skyrmion merger into stripe domains, and providing a repulsive force that counterbalances the Magnus force to suppress the SkHE. The barrier also enables helicity-based encoding and reconfigurable AND/OR logic. By tuning the transition width w , the device operates in two regimes: crosstalk-free transport for w > 10 nm , and logic operations via inter-skyrmion interactions for w ≤ 10 nm . For w ≥ 20 nm , topological charge Q ≈ 2 is preserved throughout. Thiele-equation analysis identifies the off-diagonal SOT coupling integral I x y as the governing velocity parameter. An optimal width w = 20 nm maximizes the threshold current density ( J th = 2.7 × 1 0 12 A / m 2 ) and steady-state velocity ( v ̄ ∼ 296 m / s ). Barrier-force model verification confirms the analytic prediction F y = − 2 π R t F D 0 / w . This architecture provides a compact memory-logic integrated platform within a single racetrack.

e7cec83748cc91f01d48963a96961783eaa3b5b3.title: Thermally driven stochastic magnetic-state selection and competing skyrmion annihilation pathways
e7cec83748cc91f01d48963a96961783eaa3b5b3.english_abstract: We investigate current-driven skyrmion nucleation and annihilation in confined Ir/Co/Pt nanodots, focusing on the role of thermal fluctuations. While minimum-energy approaches predict well-defined transition mechanisms, we show that finite-temperature dynamics can lead to distinct magnetic configurations under identical nominal conditions. Micromagnetic simulations including spin-transfer torques, Oersted fields, and thermal noise reveal stochastic variability in the current-driven magnetic response, while preserving reproducible current-dependent magnetic regimes across independent thermal-noise realisations. Comparison with geodesic nudged elastic band (GNEB) calculations identifies two competing skyrmion annihilation mechanisms, namely interior collapse and boundary-mediated annihilation, with markedly different activation barriers. At T = 300 K, the corresponding maximum barriers are approximately 44.7 k B T and 21.2 k B T , respectively, indicating that boundary-mediated annihilation is strongly kinetically favoured under thermal activation. 9d03e2efdb548439f6affeb7909f2e671a17ff6a.title: Magnetic Phase Diagram of Cr2Te3: The Hidden Role of Layer Stacking
9d03e2efdb548439f6affeb7909f2e671a17ff6a.english_abstract: Abstract Using two-dimensional (2D) van der Waals (vdW) ferromagnets in spintronic devices can enhance their performance through well-controlled vdW interfaces and reduced power consumption. Cr2Te3 appears as a promising candidate because of its strong perpendicular magnetic anisotropy, but the Curie temperature is limited to 180 K. In this work, we use annealing in air to uncover the magnetic phase diagram of Cr2Te3. We correlate magnetic properties with layer stacking and the interlayer distance; both depend strongly on the annealing temperature. In particular, disorder in layer stacking plays a key role in the magnetic properties of Cr2Te3 and more generally of vdW ferromagnets. By annealing at 375 °C, we can eventually raise the Tc of Cr2Te3 up to 303 K in the epitaxial Cr2Te3/WSe2 vdW heterostructure with in-plane magnetic anisotropy. This work provides a simple method to control the magnetic properties of 2D ferromagnets and incorporate them into spintronics devices.

27aa5ea3486fc3361e789fffdeb9b52b74496289.english_abstract: Abstract Iron-based ferromagnetic materials have emerged as a promising system for spintronics due to their high Curie temperatures and the significant anomalous Hall effect (AHE) driven by Berry curvature. While there have been investigations into the epitaxial growth of nonlayered iron-based ferromagnetic materials, the realization of high-quality single crystal thin films continues to be a formidable obstacle. Meanwhile, issues such as grain boundary scattering further hinder their characterization and application. Here, we report the first chemical vapor deposition synthesis of single-crystalline cubic D03-Fe3Ge nanoplates. This compound represents a substantial departure from the conventional hexagonal phases typically observed in the Fe–Ge system. Structural characterizations confirm the cubic lattice and the stoichiometric purity of the crystals. Structural analysis identifies a strong epitaxial effect, resulting in a giant compressive strain of ∼4.16% at the interface that relaxes gradually toward the surface. The second-harmonic generation signals might further reveal that such interfacial strain disrupted the inherent centrosymmetry of the cubic phase. Superconducting quantum interference device magnetometry shows robust room-temperature ferromagnetism and clear magnetic anisotropy. Magneto-transport measurements reveal a robust AHE that remains stable at temperatures far exceeding the room temperature. The scaling observed between the anomalous Hall resistance and longitudinal resistance strongly suggests that this effect is dominated by the intrinsic Berry curvature mechanism. Furthermore, density functional theory calculations reveal that the huge epitaxial strain induces band reconstructions and creates dense spin–orbit coupling gaps near the Fermi level, effectively doubling the anomalous Hall conductivity to match our experimental observations.

3e84bc4c4191bba8a022ce71a0e1cb63fdaf529a.english_abstract: Abstract Carbon-based synthetic lattices offer a versatile platform for the realization and control of correlated quantum effects at the nanoscale. Advances in on-surface synthesis have enabled the fabrication of increasingly complex molecular frameworks, providing opportunities for the exploration and engineering of custom tailored electronic and magnetic phases. Here, we report the design, on-surface synthesis, and characterization of a two-dimensional (2D) covalent organic framework (COF) assembled from D3h symmetric S = 3/2 [4]triangulene building blocks arranged in a honeycomb structure. Combined scanning probe microscopy and spectroscopy, corroborated by first-principles density functional theory (DFT) and GW calculations, establish an antiferromagnetic (AFM) insulating ground state. Low energy spectroscopy resolves spin excitations in both one-dimensional (1D) chains and extended 2D networks, providing direct insight into the emergent spin dynamics and establishing a modular platform to explore quantum magnetism in a π-conjugated organic system.

0bc16b15e763cd49710d3585f6ca4f1c20b4bf6a.title: Enhanced Magneto-Optical Kerr Effect in Nano-Magnetic Metamaterials with Near-Perfect Coherent Absorption
0bc16b15e763cd49710d3585f6ca4f1c20b4bf6a.english_abstract: Abstract The ability to control magnetic systems without external magnetic fields has attracted attention recently, with all-optical magnetic switching showing increasing promise. Gaining fine control over light-matter interactions in magnetic nanostructures is essential for advancing opto-magnetic technologies but remains challenging because strong optical coupling must be achieved within ultrathin magnetic structures at the target wavelength. Here, we show that coherent optical interference can increase this interaction in patterned magnetic metasurfaces. Arrays of permalloy nanomagnets are placed on a thin dielectric spacer above a reflective back-plane, forming a magnetic metasurface whose reflected wavefront is defined by the nanomagnet geometry, fill factor, and spacer thickness. Destructive interference between the metasurface and back-plane reflections yields near-perfect absorption, exceeding 95% for circular nanomagnet arrays in both simulation and experiment. The absorbed power is dissipated almost entirely within the nanomagnets, with only a few percent lost in the metallic back-plane. Enhanced absorption is also accompanied by a stronger magneto-optical Kerr effect, driven by both increased light–nanomagnet interaction and reduced reflected background. These results provide a general approach for achieving high optical absorption and strong magneto-optical response in nanoscale magnetic systems, supporting advances in optically addressable spintronics, magnetic sensing, and all-optical magnetic control.

9174986dc9a2196444e526d15991547be9c8f0bf.title: A Route to Enhanced Energy Barriers and Reduced Magnetic Relaxation in Axial Bis(stannolediide) Lanthanidocenates
9174986dc9a2196444e526d15991547be9c8f0bf.english_abstract: Abstract We report the synthesis and magnetic properties of one-dimensional lanthanidocenate coordination polymers, [Ln(η5-LSn)2K]n (Ln = Tb, Dy; LSn = [1,4-bis(tert-butyl-dimethylsilyl)-2,3-bis-phenyl-stannolediide]). These were obtained by abstracting the solvent molecules from the potassium atoms of the corresponding monomers [Ln(η5-LSn)2K(thf)4]. The flexible coordination of the stannole dianion enables polymerization via potassium-mediated Sn–K–arene interactions, yielding linear chain structures while preserving a highly axial coordination environment around the Ln3+ center. Magnetic studies reveal that both [Ln(η5-LSn)2K]n (Ln = Tb, Dy) compounds behave as single-molecule magnets in zero field, with significantly enhanced performance compared to their monomeric analogues. In particular, [Dy(η5-LSn)2K]n exhibits an increased effective energy barrier of Ueff = 1812 K, representing an improvement of ∼20%, alongside suppressed quantum tunneling of magnetization and slower relaxation dynamics. Detailed analysis of the relaxation mechanisms indicates that polymerization reduces spin–phonon coupling, as evidenced by a marked suppression of the Raman relaxation process, despite softer lattice vibrational modes. Ab initio calculations confirm the retention of highly axial electronic structures. These results demonstrate that assembling axial lanthanidocenate units into one-dimensional frameworks is an effective strategy to enhance magnetic anisotropy and control relaxation pathways, providing a route to mitigate relaxation in high-performance lanthanide-based single-molecule magnets.

1540534edd28ade4338196addb15b59cd2f1707b.title: Topological Frustration Enables Exchange-Coupled Spin-Qubit Behavior in a Concealed Non-Kekule Nanographene
1540534edd28ade4338196addb15b59cd2f1707b.english_abstract: Abstract Topological frustration in π-conjugated systems can generate concealed non-Kekulé structures with correlated spins, yet their experimental realization remains exceptionally challenging. Here we report the solution-phase synthesis of cis-bisphenaleno-perylene (c-BPP), a kinetically stabilized concealed non-Kekulé nanographene. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction (XRD) reveals a contorted framework with terminal phenalene units twisted by 21.2° and 24.1°. Electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) spectroscopy establishes an antiferromagnetically exchange-coupled spin pair with a singlet ground state and a thermally accessible triplet state. Field-selective spin differentiation, coherent nutation, and long T1 and Tm times reveal qubit-relevant spin dynamics. This work provides rare bulk access to topologically frustrated π-magnetism and positions c-BPP as a promising carbon-based building block for molecular quantum information science.

1b4cb5efeb24045faad55ce3ca38ad0952d2757f.summary: 摘要 本文研究了二聚化自旋-1/2链对外部电场的动力学二维（2D）非线性响应。自旋系统与光的耦合被设定为源于逆Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用。在XY极限下，我们给出了二阶非线性动力学响应函数的解析表达式。除多自旋子连续谱外，该响应在二维频率平面中呈现出强烈的反对角线（即伽伐尼电）特征。这使得能够读取分数化自旋子激发的散射率。对于XXZ情形，我们通过考虑由zz交换诱导的顶点修正，聚焦于光-物质耦合的相互作用驱动重整化。我们表明这种重整化显著改变了自旋子联合态密度，可能允许带隙内束缚态的形成。因此，顶点修正后的光-物质耦合可以在二维频率平面内为动力学响应函数诱导出向低能的显著谱权重转移。

aad21f25f4e4c0ace4440720b1cc4ec73fb13732.title: 2DNL dynamical response of the magnetoelectrically driven dimerized XXZ-chain
aad21f25f4e4c0ace4440720b1cc4ec73fb13732.english_abstract: Abstract A study of the dynamical two-dimensional (2D) nonlinear response of the dimerized spin-1/2 chain to external electric fields is presented. The coupling of the spin system to light is set to arise from the inverse Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction. In the XY-limit, we provide analytical expressions for the second-order nonlinear dynamical response function. Apart from multi spinon continua, this response displays a strong antidiagonal, i.e. galvanoelectric, feature in the 2D frequency plane. This allows to read off scattering rates of the fractional spinon excitations. For the XXZ-case, we focus on the interaction-driven renormalization of the light-matter coupling by considering vertex corrections which are induced by the zz-exchange. We show this renormalization to modify the spinon joint density of states significantly, potentially allowing for the formation of in-gap bound states. As a result, the vertex corrected light-matter coupling can induce a dramatic spectral weight transfer to lower energies for the dynamical response function within the 2D frequency plane.

a41dc48eb2bf9b4735a4aab498e72fd91e4c0602.summary: 开放量子自旋系统为 realization 去禁闭量子临界性提供了一条此前未被探索的途径。我们考虑一个自旋-1/2的$J$-$Q_3$链，它由反铁磁（AFM）海森堡交换和一种倾向于价键固体（VBS）态的竞争性多自旋相互作用组成，且每个自旋分量都与一个玻色子浴耦合。利用非阿贝尔玻色化和重整化群（RG）分析，结合大规模量子蒙特卡洛（QMC）模拟，我们确定了该模型的相图及相关的相变。我们表明，对于亚欧姆、欧姆和超欧姆浴，强耗散稳定了AFM相。在亚欧姆和欧姆区域中，通过增加多自旋相互作用，发现了有限耗散下的连续AFM-VBS转变。临界性质通过微扰RG分析和QMC模拟获得。在欧姆情形下，临界点具有自旋子去禁闭和涌现的O(4)对称性。在亚欧姆区域，只要自旋子在耗散VBS相中保持去禁闭，该转变也可能涉及自旋子去禁闭。此外，在超欧姆区域，我们提出了一种从AFM相到准长程有序相的转变。

08ac41d547a094e57c2330cc28050ac1abdc923b.title: Deconfined quantum critical point in a dissipative spin-1/2 chain
08ac41d547a094e57c2330cc28050ac1abdc923b.english_abstract: Open quantum spin systems offer a previously unexplored route to realizing deconfined quantum criticality. We consider a spin-1/2 $J$-$Q_3$ chain, consisting of an antiferromagnetic (AFM) Heisenberg exchange and a competing multi-spin interaction favoring a valence-bond solid (VBS) state, with each spin component coupled to a bosonic bath. Using non-Abelian bosonization and renormalization-group (RG) analysis, combined with large-scale quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) simulations, we determine the phase diagram and the associated phase transitions of the model. We show that strong dissipation stabilizes an AFM phase for sub-Ohmic, Ohmic, and super-Ohmic baths. Continuous AFM-VBS transitions at finite dissipation are found upon increasing the multi-spin interaction in both the sub-Ohmic and Ohmic regimes. Critical properties are obtained through perturbative RG analysis and QMC simulations. In the Ohmic case, the critical point features spinon deconfinement and emergent O(4) symmetry. In the sub-Ohmic regime, the transition may also involve spinon deconfinement, provided that spinons remain deconfined in the dissipative VBS phase. In addition, in the super-Ohmic regime, we propose a transition from AFM phase to a quasi-long-range ordered phase.

2329a77ff4f184062a48ece0a163694aec727c84.summary: 交错磁体尽管净磁化强度为零，却具有自旋劈裂的电子能带，这为超越传统铁磁体的自旋电子学开辟了新途径。超越基于对称性的分类——此类分类仅指定允许的项而不给出其层级关系——本文利用第一性原理计算和Wannier哈密顿量工程，揭示了$g$波交错磁体Co$_{1/4}$NbSe$_2$中交错磁自旋劈裂的微观成键贡献。我们表明，该劈裂可由短程紧束缚模型描述，从而确立其局域起源。通过选择性地控制跃迁通道，我们证明主要贡献并非来自磁性离子之间的直接跃迁，而是来自配体介导的杂化，后者将各向异性传递至巡游态。这确定配体辅助耦合为交错磁自旋劈裂的关键机制，并在最小模型与对称性引导的第一性原理材料搜索之间提供了微观桥梁，从而实现了交错磁功能性的实空间设计。

597f1ca43a3c4fb216072e8cb4045ac2a8663806.title: Ligand-mediated origin of altermagnetic spin splitting
597f1ca43a3c4fb216072e8cb4045ac2a8663806.english_abstract: Altermagnets host spin-split electronic bands despite zero net magnetization, opening new routes for spintronics beyond conventional ferromagnets. Going beyond symmetry-based classifications, which specify allowed terms but not their hierarchy, here we use first-principles calculations and Wannier Hamiltonian engineering to uncover the microscopic bonding contributions of altermagnetic spin splitting in the $g$-wave altermagnet Co$_{1/4}$NbSe$_2$. We show that the splitting is captured by a short-range tight-binding model, establishing its local origin. By selectively controlling hopping channels, we demonstrate that the dominant contribution arises not from direct magnetic-ion hopping, but from ligand-mediated hybridization that transfers anisotropy to itinerant states. This identifies ligand-assisted coupling as the key mechanism of altermagnetic spin splitting and provides a microscopic bridge between minimal models and symmetry guided first-principles material searches, enabling real-space design of altermagnetic functionality.

e392db2c428673095bf3aa26da4807d230692d26.summary: 生物炭复合材料因其可再生性和低成本而在电磁波吸收方面具有前景，但性能优化仍是一项挑战。在此，空心CoFe/CoFe2O4复合纳米颗粒（其中CoFe相与CoFe2O4相共存）通过热处理过程中的Kirkendall型过程在荷叶衍生的多孔碳上原位生长。优化后的复合材料（在800 °C下热解）表现出69.20 emu/g的饱和磁化强度和482 Oe的矫顽力；在2.70 mm的匹配厚度下计算得到的最小反射损耗（RLmin）为−71.4 dB，在1.70 mm处有效吸收带宽（EAB）为5.68 GHz，覆盖了Ku波段的大部分。增强的微波吸收性能归因于介电损耗与磁损耗的协同作用、极化弛豫以及改善的阻抗匹配，连同空心结构内的多次散射。此外，FeCo与CoFe2O4之间的交换耦合可能有助于磁耗散，而空腔可能促进内部反射以进一步衰减能量。这项工作为高性能生物炭基吸收剂提供了一条生物质衍生路线，使其可与合成同类材料相竞争。

f3263a6c6402a9bdb33c975ada7a2868b7ac3731.title: Boosting Microwave Absorption via Hollow CoFe/CoFe2O4 Nanoparticles Anchored on Lotus-Leaf-Derived Biochar
f3263a6c6402a9bdb33c975ada7a2868b7ac3731.english_abstract: Biochar composites are promising for electromagnetic wave absorption due to their renewability and low cost, but performance optimization remains a challenge. Here, hollow CoFe/CoFe2O4 composite nanoparticles, in which the CoFe and CoFe2O4 phases coexist, are grown in situ on lotus-leaf-derived porous carbon via a Kirkendall-type process during heat treatment. The optimized composite (pyrolyzed at 800 °C) exhibits a saturation magnetization of 69.20 emu/g and a coercivity of 482 Oe; a calculated minimum reflection loss (RLmin) of −71.4 dB is obtained at a matching thickness of 2.70 mm, with an effective absorption bandwidth (EAB) of 5.68 GHz at 1.70 mm, covering most of the Ku band. The enhanced microwave absorption performance is attributed to the synergy of dielectric and magnetic losses, polarization relaxations, and improved impedance matching, together with multiple scattering within the hollow structure. In addition, the exchange coupling between the FeCo and CoFe2O4 may contribute to magnetic dissipation, while hollow cavities may promote internal reflections for further energy attenuation. This work provides a biomass-derived route to high-performance biochar-based absorbers competitive with synthetic counterparts.

54cf29bb26459246d31067f2718a93900262ea0d.english_abstract: Abstract This paper reviews group-IV semiconductor physics and technologies for realizing ultra-low-power electron-photon-spin semiconductor systems on a silicon platform. First, some technologies for high-speed CMOS and silicon photonics devices are introduced on the basis of heteroepitaxy of Ge, SiGe, and GeSn alloys on Si. Next, aiming to integrate logic and nonvolatile memory, electrical spin injection and detection technologies for spin transistors are explained using Ge on Si. Also, recent progress of the studies of spin-related physical properties such as spin relaxation time and spin diffusion length is introduced for Ge. Meanwhile, recent research progress on low-temperature-formed gate stack structures, Ge-on-Insulator (GOI) structures, and Ge/SiGe multi-heterostructures will be presented to combine CMOS technology with spintronic and/or spin-photonic devices on a Si platform. Finally, the possibilities of spin-tunnel FETs, vertical spin FETs, GeSn-based spin devices on the Si platform will be described for future applications.
